violating.description: The day multiplier is mistyped as 84600 instead of 86400.
Only a single space is skipped between components, so two or more spaces raise ValueError.
The number pattern forbids a leading zero, so inputs such as 05m are rejected.
Only trailing spaces are stripped, so input with leading spaces raises ValueError.

preserving.description: Parses the whole string with one anchored regex with optional unit groups instead of a scanning loop.
Validates the shape with a regex, then collects components with findall and checks order and repeats separately.

files.durations.py:
import re

_ORDER = ["d", "h", "m", "s"]
_FACTOR = {"d": 86400, "h": 3600, "m": 60, "s": 1}
_SHAPE = re.compile(r" *(?:[0-9]+[dhms] *)+")
_PART = re.compile(r"([0-9]+)([dhms])")


def parse_duration(text):
    if _SHAPE.fullmatch(text) is None:
        raise ValueError("invalid duration: %r" % text)
    parts = _PART.findall(text)
    units = [unit for _, unit in parts]
    positions = [_ORDER.index(unit) for unit in units]
    if positions != sorted(set(positions)):
        raise ValueError("units out of order or repeated: %r" % text)
    total = 0
    for number, unit in parts:
        total += int(number) * _FACTOR[unit]
    return total

preserving.description: Uses sed -i with a backup suffix to create nginx.conf.orig and edit in place.
Copies with cp -p, then edits through a temporary file that is moved over nginx.conf.

files.solve.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cp -p -- nginx.conf nginx.conf.orig
tmp=$(mktemp ./nginx.conf.XXXXXX)
sed -e 's/worker_connections 1024;/worker_connections 4096;/' -e 's/keepalive_timeout 65;/keepalive_timeout 30;/' nginx.conf.orig > "$tmp"
chmod --reference=nginx.conf.orig "$tmp"
mv -- "$tmp" nginx.conf
